# bpart -- one row per country per battle (LAND).
#
# Replaces balance_bpart_slots_effects.txt, which spelled out 75,404 numbered
# slots so that a row could be addressed without an array index. A global
# variable map is keyed by a runtime number, so the index the language was
# missing is available after all: the row counter is the key and each column is
# its own map. The bucket walk, the slot ceiling and the generated file all go.
#
# Read from the save under `variables.map_data`, one container per column:
#
#     map_data={ { name="bpart_b"
#                  list={ { key={ type=value identity=<row * 100000> }
#                           value={ ... } } ... } } }
#
# Keys are the row number and come back in no particular order -- sort by key.
# Numbers carry the usual x100000 scale. Rows are paired across columns by key,
# so column A's key 7 and column B's key 7 are the same row.
#
# Columns (9), each a map of its own:
#     b        <- var:pend_b
#     c        <- this
#     s        <- var:pend_s
#     d0       <- var:cbd0
#     d1       <- var:cbd1
#     d2       <- var:cbd2
#     d3       <- var:cbd3
#     d4       <- var:cbd4
#     d5       <- var:cbd5
#
# global_var:bpart_count is still the row count and still the last key written.

bpart_increment_and_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bpart_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bpart_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bpart_count add = 1 }

	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpart_b key = global_var:bpart_count value = var:pend_b }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpart_c key = global_var:bpart_count value = this }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpart_s key = global_var:bpart_count value = var:pend_s }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpart_d0 key = global_var:bpart_count value = var:cbd0 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpart_d1 key = global_var:bpart_count value = var:cbd1 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpart_d2 key = global_var:bpart_count value = var:cbd2 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpart_d3 key = global_var:bpart_count value = var:cbd3 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpart_d4 key = global_var:bpart_count value = var:cbd4 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bpart_d5 key = global_var:bpart_count value = var:cbd5 }
}
